name: Stage 45: Lindbacke to Oppeby (via Nyköping)
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 45, Lindbacke to Oppeby (via Nyköping).
utilities: Nyköping provides train/bus, cafes, hotels, groceries, toilets, and resupply, especially around Nyköpingshus, the bus station, Sörmlands museum, the harbour, central Nyköping, and Oppeby.
No official Sörmlandsleden shelter, campsite, or potable trail-water point was verified on stage 45 itself. Treat this as an urban day section and use town services during opening hours.

Default-map food/service markers should stay curated: show start/end groceries, central museum/castle/harbour/bus-station facilities, a few close cafes/restaurants, and keep dense central restaurant options searchable rather than all pinned by default.
waterSources: Use urban services rather than trail taps: museum/cafes/restaurants, groceries, public toilets with sinks, and possible harbour drinking-water points. Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water availability/quality.
A harbour-side OSM drinking-water point exists but is roughly 0.5-0.6 km off the main Stage 45 line and should be treated as seasonal/verify-on-site until field-confirmed.
The Ryssbergen tap/water point southwest of Lindbacke is around the 2 km/off-route edge for Stage 45 and belongs primarily to Stage 44/44:1 planning, not this urban stage.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 8 km; Naturkartan measures about 8.1 km/8,328 m and marks it green/easy, OSM relation 6575118 measures closer to 8.3 km despite a stale 10 km tag, Äventyrligare lists about 8.23 km, and the local official-GPX line is about 7.8 km. The route is an urban/river/park stage: Lindbacke shops, Oxelösundsvägen tunnel, Idbäck, Teaterparken, bus station, Hamnvägen, Nyköpingshus, Nyköpingsån/Åpromenaden, Hållet-Marieberg-Stenbro, E4 underpass, and Oppeby.

For route-builder snapping, use OSM node 3223700234 at 58.744822,16.994087 for the Stage 44/45 Lindbacke join, OSM node 4354585315 at 58.770413,16.974096 for the Stage 45/46/46:1 Oppeby join, OSM node 1816581778 at 58.748679,17.009761 for the 45:1 Nyköpingshus branch context, and OSM node 522418486 at 58.763651,16.999452 for the Hållet/legacy 44:2/45:2 context.

Official Sörmlandsleden stage page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Current local caveat: Nyköping resecentrum construction continues toward 2028; station-area access has changed, northern commuter parking and a pedestrian tunnel were permanently closed in March 2026, and Brunnsgatan/station-area works have planned closures in summer 2026 and week 44 2026 plus a longer partial closure planned in 2028. Follow live signs and municipal notices near Nyköping C, Brunnsgatan, the bus station, and Nyköpingsån.

Hållet-Marieberg-Stenbro reserve rules apply on the river/reserve part: dogs/cats/pets leashed, fires only at prepared fireplaces, no camping/camp activity without Nyköping municipality permission, do not disturb animals or breeding sites, and do not damage rock/stone/live or dead trees. Current 2025 reserve decision was appealed, but updated C-rules still apply.

Nyköping public-place rules restrict camping/tenting to designated areas such as Strandstuguviken, Örstig, and Västra Hamnsidan unless a police permit applies; do not present stage 45 as a wild-camping stage.

Fire status checked 2026-04-27: local rescue service did not show an active fire ban, but Länsstyrelsen pages showed a forest-fire-risk warning for Södermanland. Check live fire status before using even designated grills.
Nearby Svanviken/Lindbacke context: the Kilaån footbridge in Svanviken reserve is closed as unsafe, but this is a detour/adjacent warning rather than an official stage 45 closure.

Trip reports/blogs generally describe the first urban/industrial part from Lindbacke/Idbäck toward Nyköpingshus as functional and less scenic, while the Nyköpingsån/river, Storhusfallet, old buildings, cafes, Hållet mining-history signs, and Hållet green corridor are the pleasant part. Official/Naturkartan easy grading should override AllTrails' generic moderate label.

Wayfinding risk is mainly urban route-choice complexity around Nyköping's mainline, access routes, branches and loops: Stage 45 relates to 44, 45:1, 45:2, 46, 46:1, the older 44:2/Kungsladugården-Hållet connector, and local Lindbacke/Svanviken loops. Keep branch options separate and show them only when relevant.
